title: IISc Open Day 2025
description: Databased's showcase at IISc Open Day 2025 — interactive demos including terrain generation, Nim game, Tic-Tac-Toe with AI, and cryptography challenges.

title: Hack and Seek 2025
description: Capture the Flag competition testing skills in web exploitation, cryptography, reverse engineering, forensics, and binary exploitation.

title: Algorithm Festival 2024
description: A day-long competitive programming contest with problems from beginner to expert difficulty, featuring live rankings and prizes.

title: Ideathon 2024
description: A 24-hour hackathon-style ideathon where teams pitched and prototyped solutions to real-world problems using data science and AI.

title: IISc Open Day 2024
description: Our Open Day booth featured interactive exhibits on algorithms, computer vision, and cybersecurity for school students and visitors.

title: Intro to Machine Learning
description: Hands-on workshop covering ML fundamentals — from linear regression to neural networks — with live coding sessions in Python and scikit-learn.

title: Operating Systems: Under the Hood
description: Guest talk on modern OS design, memory management, and scheduling algorithms by a researcher from the CDS department.

title: Full-Stack Web Development
description: Three-session workshop on modern web development covering HTML/CSS/JS fundamentals, React, and backend APIs with Node.js.

title: Alumni Session: Life After IISc
description: Panel discussion with IISc alumni at Google, Amazon, and top research labs — covering career paths, research vs. industry, and advice for undergrads.

title: Mathematics for CS Series
description: Five-session series covering discrete math, combinatorics, probability, and linear algebra — essential foundations for any CS student.

title: Paradox Festival
description: An event introducing the audience to the world of paradoxes in science and mathematics — from Berry's Paradox to Banach-Tarski.

title: Databased Launch Event
description: The inaugural event of Databased — introducing the club, its vision, and the activities planned for the year to new B.Tech. students.
